name: Gorgetosuchus
sum: Gorgetosuchus is an aetosaur from the Late Triassic Pekin Formation of North Carolina, known mainly from osteoderms.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Osteoderms including the front half of an articulated carapace (Heckert et al. 2015).
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Heckert et al. 2015
